entities.summary:
Stefano de Normandis dei Conti was an Italian cardinal from the medieval period.

Born in unknown circumstances, Stefano rose through the ranks of the Catholic Church to become a prominent figure in the papal court. His family connections, particularly his uncle Pope Innocent III, played a significant role in securing his appointment as a cardinal.

Stefano's tenure as a cardinal was marked by several notable events, including his involvement in the Fifth Crusade and his diplomatic efforts to secure alliances between European powers.

Despite his prominent position, Stefano de Normandis dei Conti left behind no lasting legacy, with most of his actions being overshadowed by those of his contemporaries. However, his involvement in key historical events continues to be studied by historians seeking to understand the complexities of medieval politics and diplomacy.

The exact date of his death remains unknown, but it is believed to have occurred in 1254.
